description.value: The study examined whether prequit fMRI reactivity to smoking-related images, emotional Stroop attentional bias, and insula-network functional connectivity could distinguish smokers who later slipped from those who maintained abstinence.

spans.text: Before quitting smoking, 21 nicotine-dependent women underwent fMRI during which smoking-related and neutral images were shown.

design.value: Twenty-one nicotine-dependent women underwent prequit fMRI and emotional Stroop testing, then attempted smoking cessation and were grouped according to whether they slipped or maintained abstinence.
